data.one_liner: TextEditingController and RichText builder for hashtag, url, mention and emoji detection.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized TextEditingController and RichText span builder that detects common social media elements like hashtags, mentions, URLs, and emojis using regular expressions. It includes event streams for tracking detections and helper widgets for presenting contextual popups above the text field.
use_when: You are building a social media app or comment section requiring hashtag and mention highlighting.
You need to detect and make URLs or emojis interactive within a TextField.
You want to listen to content detection events as the user types.
avoid_when: You need complex rich-text editing capabilities like bold, italics, or custom paragraph styling.
You are not using a TextField or TextSpan-based workflow.
strengths: Out-of-the-box regex support for hashtags, mentions, URLs, and emojis.
Provides a detection event stream and tap support for detected items.
Includes customizable text styles per detected content type.
weaknesses: Relies on custom regex modifications for advanced or localized syntax beyond defaults.
Limited to specific pre-defined detection types (mention, hashtag, url, plain_text).
